s3_rules.classes: PN* = {TWIN, PN*_a1, PN*_a2}; BINT = {TWIN, BINT}; EAP = {TWIN, EAP}; IFG = {TWIN, IFG_hot}; TEMP = {TWIN, T1.3}; TOPK10 = {TWIN, TOPK10}
s3_rules.hull: exp27 hull_full.hull_prices_full: correct-only Hill-1 rarefied at depth 25, two-stage CRN multinomial draws (n_draws 1,000), simplex grid 0.01 (k <= 3) + local refinement -> H5, P15, P20; 2,000 slot bootstraps with best-mixture selection inside each replicate
s3_rules.per_task: WIN if P_boot(H5_PN* > H5_BINT) >= 0.8, LOSS if <= 0.2, else TIE; 'matches or beats' = WIN/TIE
s3_rules.replay: D_t = H5_PN* - max(H5 of BINT, EAP, IFG); D_bar with bootstrap CI; count PN* >= best text
s3_rules.knob_check: reuse exp27's N 50 rows (relabelled) iff per-slot label agreement >= 0.95 (10/10) on k 0-1
s3_rules.retag: iteration-5 plan-sampler verdict and movability verdict tagged 'ban-free unit and iteration-5 seeds'; new verdicts at D*: movable := alpha-2 correct off-default share - twin >= 0.20 at pass >= 0.8 x twin
